method: root review of lines 41-80 against source and immediate context

corrections.old: If Onogor shoots, the bullet will not go through,
corrections.en: Even if an onogor gun fires, its bullet cannot pierce it,
corrections.reason: Onogor is a type of gun; the line says its bullet cannot pierce the armor.

corrections.old: It will not pass if they turn,
corrections.en: And in a wrestling struggle, no hand can get through.
corrections.reason: Armor blocks a hand in wrestling, not a person passing.

corrections.en: Fitted to the body,
corrections.reason: Corrects the English against the printed Kyrgyz line and surrounding syntax.

corrections.en: It was stitched with a master’s firm stitches.
corrections.reason: кайыган denotes stitching, in this armor-making sequence.

corrections.en: Even if six thousand spears thrust at once,
corrections.reason: Thrusting spears, not “six thousand spears thrust one”.

corrections.en: They could not reach through to the other side,
corrections.reason: Corrects the English against the printed Kyrgyz line and surrounding syntax.

corrections.en: But glanced away in every direction.
corrections.reason: Spears glance off in all directions.
